title: Number of Music Playlists
goal: Count playlists of length goal using every song while requiring k other songs before a repeat.
strategy: DP tracks playlist length and how many distinct songs have appeared. Add an unused song in n-used+1 ways, or replay one of used-k eligible songs; the final state must use all n songs.

phasePurposes.done: Count playlists of length goal using every song while requiring k other songs before a repeat.

edgeCases: A playlist of n positions uses each song once
One song can repeat when the gap is zero
A gap of n minus one forces cyclic reuse after the first order
